rationale: Reference baseline and lineage root of the spec of the third committee, not a candidate: the slots of the root of the second committee spec, each carried to its member model with the fuel table (the roots of the fuel-table specs, with the neutral table), and the committee lines of that root (weights, era rule, offsets of the planned stop). No number was taken from the PSI-159 tables. The slot values are copied from the stored releases by tools/wsp/committee3_edits.py, which chooses nothing. Data-informed candidates of acme_inverse-wsp-v12 are literal revisions of this release, so that the registry records them as revisions with development exposure.
